deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT — canary errors detected in prod-api-canary. 5xx rate > 25% for last 3m. Incident ID: INC-20260315-0872
maya: ack — oncall (maya) here, taking. giving timeline in a sec.
austin: I can confirm spike from frontend traces, ~60% of requests to /v1/generate -> 502 from model-proxy. Canary only.
maya: running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep canary` shows restarts on api-canary-.*
ryan: seeing identical stacktrace in logs: "failed to pull image: manifest unknown" followed by fallback to cached image -> checksum mismatch. sending log snippet.
samira: paste logs? I was looking at CI run for the canary rollout — the deploy job printed image tag `redwood/api:build-988` but deploy manifest used `redwood/api:build-987`.
ryan: here's the k8s error snippet:
```
Warning  Failed     21s (x3 over 30s)  kubelet, ip-10-0-2-45  Failed to pull image "redwood/api:build-987": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = manifest unknown: manifest unknown
```
maya: ok that explains it — wrong image tag pushed to cluster. sounds like CI promoted the wrong tag or the deploy job pulled from cache.
austin: can we kill the canary route and roll back to previous stable? I want to avoid wider impact.
maya: initiating rollback now: running `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=42`
deploy-bot: :information_source: Deploy job 1710579001 started by infra-ci (pipeline/canary-deploy).
ryan: quick mitigation: toggle canary flag to 0% traffic in gateway feature flags — `ffctl set canary_api_traffic 0`
samira: done — ffctl response: "canary_api_traffic -> 0 (was 10)" :thumbsup:
maya: rollback completed on deployment/api — pods terminating and recreating with image `redwood/api:stable-20260314`
austin: monitoring metrics... 5xx rate dropping back down to baseline. good.
sre-ops: filing incident: root cause suspected: CI pipeline uses a cached artifact resolver that can return stale tag mapping when concurrent builds run; deploy job currently relies on tag (mutable) instead of digest.
maya: immediate follow-ups: 1) enforce image digest pinning in deploy manifests; 2) fail deploy if resolved digest != registry manifest; 3) add a strong check in CI to prevent reusing tag names; 4) postmortem + notify customers affected.
ryan: temporary hotfix in CI: stop using 'latest-like' ephemeral tags for promoted artifacts. will open PR to switch to immutable digest-based promotion (CI: #2345).
samira: I can do the postmortem doc and customer impact notes — initial estimate: 2 canary customers saw degraded responses for ~8 minutes.
maya: great. leaving oncall to austin in 10m for takeover. handoff notes: rollback done, mitigation toggled, CI short-term guard added.
austin: taking oncall — thanks. will watch for any regressions and follow up on CI PRs.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-20260315-0872 acknowledged and mitigated (canary rollback + flag kill). Followups assigned: CI-2345 (digest pin), DEPLOY-789 (deploy validation).
